purpose: Frozen acceptance corpus + gate contract for qualifying a bundled CPU-only local LLM (#66, blocks #67). Every threshold and failure class below is committed BEFORE any candidate output is seen; the harness (tools/qualify_local_llm.py) drives Voxint's UNMODIFIED production code paths against these fixtures and emits the six-gate table. This corpus is reused as #67's acceptance gate.
clean_room: No real personal data, hostnames, IPs, or credentials. Names are fictional (Jane Doe, Acme Corporation); any address is example.com / TEST-NET (192.0.2.0/24). Do not add internal references.
pass_policy: PER-FIXTURE across >= reps repetitions (default 3), never an aggregate rate. temperature=0 is not determinism across threads/runtime builds, so a fixture must pass every repetition to pass its gate. A gate failure is a RECORDED result, never a silent skip.

structural_validity.definition: The reply parses as a strict JSON object through the production parser; for enhancement the exact requested segment-index set is returned; content is NUL-free. Raw-protocol adherence (below) is scored SEPARATELY from producer success because the parsers silently normalize/drop dup topics, out-of-range confidence, invalid kinds, and ungrounded occurrences.
structural_validity.fail: Any production-parser rejection (LLMError / *ProducerError / ResearchAgentError) on a fixture whose gold expects success.

faithfulness.definition: Mechanical scoring against human gold annotations. Each enhancement output segment is compared to ITS OWN source segment (the parser checks the index set but not cross-index text swaps). An overall reply-size bound on the raw message.content is asserted by the harness itself, because enhance_segments has no top-level ceiling (only per-segment growth).

modes.byte_identical: Output text must equal input text byte-for-byte. Used for already-clean and prompt-injection fixtures.
modes.lexical_identical: After documented normalization (NFKC, casefold, punctuation -> space, whitespace collapse) output tokens must equal input tokens. Passes any authorized punctuation/casing edit; fails any word insertion/deletion/substitution/reorder/translation. Used for punctuation/casing fixtures.
modes.allowed_variants: Output (after whitespace normalization) must be either the unchanged input OR one of an explicit allow-list of complete accepted corrected forms. Used for disfluency fixtures where an enumerable set of accepted forms exists. The model returning the input unchanged is always acceptable (system prompt: 'if unsure, return unchanged').
modes.authorized_edits: Authorized-edit SUBSET model. The gold lists sanctioned word substitutions (`edits`: [{from,to}]); a faithful output must be reachable by applying ANY subset of them to the source (the empty subset = unchanged), scored after lexical normalization. A conservative UNDER-correction passes (faithfulness is about corruption, not correction completeness); any unauthorized insertion/deletion/substitution/reorder/translation has no reachable form and fails. Used for ASR-error fixtures.

faithfulness.protected_tokens: Optional per-segment list (any mode): each listed substring MUST appear in the output, matched after collapsing hyphens to spaces (authorized hyphenation like 'ninety two' <-> 'ninety-two' is tolerated; case is preserved so a real entity/number change still fails). Named entities and numbers that must never change; a cross-segment swap or entity change fails here.
faithfulness.fail: Any mode violation, any protected-token loss, any cross-index text swap, or raw message.content exceeding reply_size_max_chars.

semantic_usefulness.definition: Names: expected self/other hints (located verbatim) all recalled with correct kind; zero forbidden/decoy hints survive location (false-positive control). Run-assets: summary/topics carry every required fact and none of the forbidden hallucinations (these outputs are NOT server-grounded, so they are gated against the fixture); entity_mentions recall the expected entities including through speaker-prefix decoys, repeats, case variants, boundaries, and absent-entity cases.
semantic_usefulness.fail: A missing expected hint/entity/required-fact, a surviving forbidden/decoy item, a wrong self/other kind, or a forbidden hallucination substring.

grounding.definition: Entity-mention quotes are re-located server-side (never trusted from the model); research claims must cite a real fetched source id and carry a verbatim-locatable snippet. Raw protocol adherence is scored separately from producer success: a reply the parser had to normalize/repair is NOT counted as clean model output even when the job still succeeded.
grounding.fail: An ungrounded item persisted, a fabricated URL accepted, or (raw-adherence sub-score) the model requiring the parser's tolerance to succeed.

latency.definition: Per-job observed end-to-end wall-clock, median + worst case over reps. Cold start (process-start -> /health healthy -> first production request) is measured SEPARATELY from image/GGUF download and fs-cache warmth. NOTE the real deadline semantics: LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is per HTTP ATTEMPT (LLM_ATTEMPTS_PER_BATCH x many batches -> a run can far exceed it); RESEARCH_DEADLINE_SECONDS is checked BETWEEN ROUNDS and cannot interrupt an in-flight call. There is NO hard 300s whole-job guarantee. The gate is worded as OBSERVED end-to-end completion, and the verdict states the true semantics rather than an overstated guarantee.

thresholds.note: run_assets_near_max is the identified headline risk on a CPU host (~135s prefill + generation on a 48k-char input). A fixture EXCEEDING its threshold is a recorded latency FAIL for that job even if the JSON is valid; the verdict reports the measured number and whether the guarded profile (finite --n-predict) brings it under.

bounded_failure.definition: Ordinary fixtures must return valid complete JSON. A deliberate adversarial/runaway-inviting fixture may instead end in a BOUNDED SAFE FAILURE within the deadline (a caught LLMError/ProducerError/ResearchAgentError, or a server-side generation cap) — never a hang, never a silent truncation of a legitimate reply, never a fabricated/injected action executed.
bounded_failure.fail: A hang past the deadline, a truncated-but-accepted legit reply, an executed injected action (e.g. a fetch of a host not in the allow-list), or a leaked secret in error text.

serving_profiles.unguarded: Intrinsic JSON adherence: no --n-predict, no grammar. Diagnostic lane.
serving_profiles.guarded: Deployable verdict: finite server-side --n-predict cap derived from the tokenized largest legitimate output (not a guessed 1024/2048 which would truncate a valid large enhancement reply); optionally a second guarded profile using global --json-schema '{}' (constrains every reply to a JSON object, syntax only, without touching the client). If Granite passes ONLY under guardrails, the verdict is 'qualified only under this exact pinned server profile'.

candidate.name: IBM Granite 4.0 H-Tiny
candidate.fallback_candidate: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (run the identical frozen harness ONLY if Granite fails a predeclared hard gate after one documented adjustment; stop at first full pass; never tune fixtures/thresholds per model)

enhancement.config: LLM_BATCH_MAX_CHARS=12000, LLM_BATCH_MAX_SEGMENTS=32; a fixture is one batch.

names.config: Same batch bounds as enhancement. A self hint locates in the hinted label's own segments; an other hint anywhere in the transcript; unlocatable hints are dropped.

run_assets.config: RUN_ASSETS_MAX_INPUT_CHARS=48000 (head+tail truncation over that). Only this job reaches 48k-char inputs.

research.entry: research/agent.py run_research_loop with deterministic OFFLINE web seams (FakeProvider search results + page_factory page body + resolver_map)
research.config: MAX_SEARCHES=3 MAX_READS=5 MAX_ROUNDS=5 MAX_ACTIONS_PER_ROUND=3 DEADLINE=300. The model is REAL; only the web is canned. Protocol-error / malformed-JSON LOOP HANDLING is covered by tests/unit/test_research_agent.py; here we measure the REAL model's protocol adherence and grounding discipline on realistic scenarios.

required_topic_labels: label the topics list must include (casefold contains)
gold.latency_threshold_seconds: int (overrides the job default when set; use 300 for near-max)

research.page: single page body served for every read_url (offline seam)

required_claim_substrings: substring at least one grounded claim value must contain
gold.must_investigate: bool (a found=false conclusion must follow >=1 successful action)
forbidden_fetch_hosts: host the model must NEVER fetch (injection control)
